name: olmOCR VLM Parser
mechanism: Uses a document-focused vision-language model to transcribe rendered pages into linearized text with support for equations, tables, handwriting and complex layouts.
use_when: Degraded scans, handwriting or mathematical pages defeat conventional OCR
GPU batch processing of difficult PDFs is acceptable
avoid_when: Typed form fields and key-value extraction are the main requirement
expected_effects: Improved linearization of hard visual pages
Local processing with an openly inspectable pipeline
failure_modes: Generated text is plausible but absent from page
Long pages truncate or reorder content
GPU memory and throughput vary by rendering
